# BBSTransform

*Common*

Translation, rotation and scale of a BBS form, from `scram.transform()` or [`getTransform()`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm#gettransform). Rotation is in degrees, as in the BBS editor. Setters return this transform, so calls can be chained; changes of the transform of a form apply to that form at once.

```js
var form = c.getPlayer().getForm();

form.getTransform().setTranslate(0, 0.5, 0).setRotate(0, 90, 0).setScale(2, 2, 2);
c.getPlayer().setForm(form);
```

## Methods

### getTransform {#gettransform}

::: member

**Returns** `Transform` — the BBS transform this object reads and changes

### setScale {#setscale}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | scale along X, 1 for the original size |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | scale along Y |
| `z` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | scale along Z |

**Returns** [`BBSTransform`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSTransform) — this transform

:::

::: member

| --- | --- | --- |
| `vector` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | scale along each axis, 1 for the original size |

**Returns** [`BBSTransform`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSTransform) — this transform

:::

### getScale {#getscale}
